description:
You are a Technical SEO auditing a news publisher's AMP implementation. Configure Screaming Frog SEO Spider to crawl and validate Accelerated Mobile Pages (AMP). 

STEPS:
1. Open Screaming Frog and configure it to 'Crawl' and 'Store' AMP data (Configuration > Spider > Crawl > Parse HTML to extract AMP Links / Configuration > Spider > AMP > Check AMP Compliance).
2. Crawl 'https://crawler-test.com/'.
3. Wait for the crawl to finish.
4. Navigate to the 'AMP' tab to view results.
5. Export the AMP audit data to a CSV file in '~/Documents/SEO/exports/'. The filename must contain 'amp'.
6. Write a short text report to '~/Documents/SEO/reports/amp_audit_report.txt' listing at least 2 specific AMP errors found (e.g., 'Missing Canonical', 'Validation Error') and the total count of AMP pages found.
